title: Concept: Download piped to shell (shell) — review required
description: Piping a download into a shell (curls+[^|]*|s*(?:ba|z|k|fi|da)?shb) executes unverified network bytes with the user's authority. TLS alone does not make this safe: server compromise or partial reads still execute. The remedy is fetch-verify-run (checksum/signature verification).
applicability: shell install scripts and runbooks; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Remote code execution on installer runs; HIGH severity.
